claims.statement: EUDR requires operators or traders placing covered commodities on the EU market or exporting them to prove they are not linked to recent deforestation or forest degradation.
The Commission launched the EUDR Information System in December 2024.

economics.acquisition_route: Land one Polish buyer, onboard its supplier cohort, then cross-sell sharing to other buyers
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 2500 suppliers at 5000 PLN blended recurring revenue could reach 12.5m PLN ARR; a 60% founder stake could exceed 5m PLN in years 5-8
economics.founder_time: 3-5 hours/day with specialist legal and geospatial reviews contracted
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 70-88% after satellite and document-review costs
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 1500-6000 PLN per supplier/year plus 150 PLN per additional buyer share
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual renewal and event-driven updates to plots, products or legality records

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Repeated use builds a unique map of supplier plots, document changes and buyer acceptance outcomes
fingerprint.customer: Small non-EU producers, EU traders and Polish downstream manufacturers in EUDR scope
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Polish furniture, rubber and food associations plus importer invitations to suppliers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Geospatial validation, document vault, permissions, versioning and Information-System-ready exports; not a certification
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Supplier or lead buyer pays annual passport fee; additional buyers pay per shared packet
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A supplier must repeatedly answer buyer requests for plot, legality and deforestation evidence

founder_fit: Geospatial and data-lineage work suits the founder
A buyer-led onboarding motion minimizes public selling
risks: Supplier data may be false or incomplete

structure.critical_dependency: The workflow must match current EUDR simplifications and official information-system interfaces

thesis: Create a reusable, consented geolocation-and-legality packet for small commodity producers that multiple Polish furniture, tyre, coffee or chocolate buyers can reference without duplicating collection.
title: EUDR Plot-Evidence Passport
uncertainties: Demand, pricing and acceptable reuse boundaries are unvalidated
